label: Timeline B — same phases, breakthrough energy suppressed / moved earlier
notes: Control arm. Same story text and phase names; energy curve and timing differ so compiled music plan must change.

phases.name: Opening
phases.musical_intent: sparse piano and soft pads; space and breath; almost still

phases.name: Challenge
phases.musical_intent: low strings enter; unresolved harmony; held tension under calm surface

phases.name: Breakthrough
phases.emotional_state: premature opening that does not fully land
phases.musical_intent: brief lift that fails to bloom; restrained dynamics; no triumphant crest

phases.name: Struggle
phases.emotional_state: difficulty reconnecting after the false opening
phases.musical_intent: denser restless texture; heavier percussion; pressure without catharsis

phases.name: Turning Point
phases.emotional_state: small act of service cracks the isolation
phases.musical_intent: harmonic shift toward light; melody fragment appears; careful forward motion

phases.name: Resolution
phases.emotional_state: quiet unresolved settle — softer than Timeline A
phases.musical_intent: texture thins further; fragile piano; open cadence; ambiguity remains
